title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
description:
arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead.
